data.name: Layla
data.gender_notes: Layla is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ل-ي-ل (l-y-l), 'night'. Laylā means 'night' or 'one born at night'. Its root is ل-ي-ل (l-y-l). The beloved in the classical Arabic love story Laylā wa-Majnūn. Layla is a Arabic name meaning “Night; one born at night”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Layla expresses “Night; one born at night”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ل-ي-ل (l-y-l), 'night'. Laylā means 'night' or 'one born at night'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Layla total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
